# Rob Iula

> Rob Iula is Head of Growth at Cindie.ai, which is building the AI workforce for mortgage. He has spent 15+ years in digital marketing and IT building the campaigns, data, and CRM playbooks that get lenders and loan officers producing. He's based in Orange County, California.

## About

- [Home](https://robiu.la/): who Rob is, what he works on now, his track record, and how to reach him
- Now: Head of Growth at [Cindie.ai](https://cindie.ai) since August 2026
- Before that: Director of Digital Marketing at Insellerate, a mortgage CRM and engagement platform
- Instant Channel: employee number three, helped build InstantIQ (a proprietary email SaaS) and helped scale the company to about $35M and an acquisition
- Rocket Media: founded and ran his own CRM and lifecycle agency for six years
- Started in IT and systems, then moved into email and marketing ops, including a run as an Email Marketing Director
- Web3: founding member of PROOF Collective (Kevin Rose's NFT collective, later acquired by Yuga Labs) and of Skylab
- Focus: demand gen and ABM, lifecycle and reactivation across email and SMS, CRM and campaign ops, and reporting tied to closed business

## Writing

- [My Journey with the PROOF Collective: Early NFT Adoption, Community Building, and Networking with Industry Leaders](https://robiu.la/articles/proof-collective): As an early member of PROOF Collective, I navigated the explosive growth of NFTs, forged relationships with industry leaders, and played a role in shaping projects like Grails and Moonbirds. Here's my story about spotting opportunities early and building community. Published March 10, 2025.
- [How CRM Strategy and Innovative Thinking Transformed Our Email Marketing Success at Instant Channel](https://robiu.la/articles/crm-strategy-instant-channel): Falling inbox placement and a CRM that didn't talk to our email tools. Here's how we fixed both at Instant Channel, and what it did for revenue. Published October 1, 2024.
